availability: Every hourly forecast has 48h lead, so even last target-day hour was predicted at least24h before end of origin; not target-day realised weather. API docs describe lead, exact publication files not independently recovered.
aggregation: Daily mean only if24 forecasts exist, otherwise previous daily forecast carried forward, with missingness flag. Initial no-forecast context zero, outside histories used by frozen windows.
locations: London, Birmingham, Manchester, Glasgow; each separate proxy, not exact national area weights.
mechanism: Heating/cooling demand and weather-driven price/supply; cold threshold15C and warm22C are uncalibrated feature basis choices.
